app.name: CouchPad
app.tagline: Gaming from the comfort of your couch
recovery.help: Automation is paused until recovery is complete. Retrying recovery will reopen CouchPad.
recovery.retry_help: Starts the separate rescue; CouchPad reopens after recovery.
recovery.failed: Recovery could not be completed. Check your display and audio connections before trying again.
errors.audio.endpointUnavailable: The TV audio output was not found. Pick the TV HDMI output in the audio card.
errors.display.unsupportedMode: The TV does not advertise {0}×{1} @ {2} Hz. Turn on Input Signal Plus (HDMI 2.0) on the TV or pick a mode it advertises.
errors.display.displayNotReady: The TV did not activate as a monitor. Check that it is on and on the right HDMI input.
errors.display.modeVerificationFailed: The TV did not confirm the resolution or refresh change.
errors.display.scaleFailed: The TV scale could not be applied.
errors.display.topologyVerificationFaile: The display configuration could not be confirmed.
profiles.title: Environment profiles
profiles.help: Each profile stores the TV, internal monitor, and audio output. Changes are saved to the selected profile.
profiles.name: Profile name
diagnosis.title: Identification diagnosis
diagnosis.help: Shows how the TV, monitor, and audio output were chosen. Nothing is changed.
diagnosis.later: may appear after the TV is turned on
diagnosis.reason.tv_auto: Reason: only inactive HDMI TV with EDID.
diagnosis.reason.monitor_auto: Reason: only active non-HDMI monitor with EDID.
diagnosis.reason.manual: Reason: manual selection; confirm before applying.
diagnosis.reason.unavailable: Reason: the device is not available now.
diagnosis.reason.audio_exact: Reason: endpoint name equals the TV name.
diagnosis.reason.audio_prefix: Reason: endpoint name starts with the TV name.
diagnosis.reason.audio_manual: Reason: endpoint was chosen manually or has no name match.
diagnosis.summary.simple: Summary: two clear displays; inactive HDMI TV and active monitor.
diagnosis.summary.multiple: Summary: more than two displays or candidates; selection may need to be manual.
diagnosis.summary.audio_ambiguous: Summary: more than one output matches the TV name.
diagnosis.summary.complete: Summary: selection is complete; use Test sound to confirm.
diagnosis.summary.incomplete: Summary: choices are missing or a device is unavailable.
countdown.help: Choose how long to wait when the controller connects and disconnects.
automation.help: Turn on to react when the controller connects.
automation.setup_tv: Choose the TV that will receive the picture.
automation.setup_monitor: Choose the monitor to restore after playing.
automation.setup_distinct: Choose a different device for the TV and monitor.
automation.setup_audio: Choose the TV audio output in the Transition card.
automation.setup_unavailable_devices: A selected device is unavailable. Refresh the list or choose another one.
automation.setup_apply: Review the suggested or selected devices and apply the configuration.
automation.suggest_manual: Some devices could not be suggested. Choose the remaining devices.
automation.suggest_audio_ambiguous: More than one output matches the TV name. Choose one and use Test sound when it is available.
automation.apply_failed: Could not apply the configuration. Automation is still off.
automation.applied: Configuration applied. You can now turn automation on.
audio.test_inactive: The HDMI output may appear when the TV is active in Windows.
audio.test_playing: Playing a tone on the selected output…
audio.test_finished: Test complete. Check that you heard sound on the expected device.
audio.test_failed: Could not play on this output. Refresh the list and try again.
audio.inventory_failed: Could not refresh the audio outputs.
display.target_hint: Choose the TV and monitor. Then apply the configuration in the Automation card.
display.target_hint_simulation: Choose the TV and monitor for display diagnostics.
display.targets_error: Could not list displays. Check the connection and try again.
display.tv_mode_hint: Choose the resolution and refresh rate used on the TV while automation is on.
display.tv_scale_hint: Scale applies to Windows while the TV is active; it may apply only to apps opened later.
display.tv_mode_unavailable: The TV modes could not be read. Automation will use the Windows default mode.
automation.setup_required: Select the TV, a different monitor, and the TV audio output to set up automation.
automation.setup_unavailable: The recovery component is unavailable. Reinstall CouchPad to set up automation.
update.check: Check for new versions on GitHub
gamepad.simulated_help: Local simulation: no real controller is used.
combo.change_reason: Available when button capture is active.
settings.startup_error: Windows startup could not be updated.
settings.start_with_windows_help: Creates a per-user task; CouchPad opens at logon.
settings.minimize_to_tray_help: When you close the window, CouchPad stays in the tray.
audio.restart_help: Select the output used by the chosen display mode and restart after changing these options.
settings.allow_display_writes_help: Advanced: enables CCD and the recovery watchdog. Restart after changing; use only with the TV connected.
settings.real_gamepad_help: Uses XInput to detect controllers. Restart CouchPad after changing this option.
settings.help: Applied only when automation is on.
audio.restore_help: On exit, the previous output and volume are restored, even if changed during the session.
launchers.failed: Could not start or close the launcher. Display and audio can still be restored.
language.label: Language
about.title: About CouchPad
about.description: Turn on your controller to play on the TV. CouchPad switches the display and audio and can open Steam or Hydra in Big Picture. Turn off your controller to restore your previous display and audio.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every state, without touching hardware.
gallery.row.label: Label
gallery.buttons.help: Hover, press or navigate with Tab to see hover, pressed and focus.
